title: Is This a Search Tree
statement:
A binary tree has `n` nodes numbered `1..n`; node `1` is the root. Node `i` holds the value `v_i`, and you are given its left and right child (`0` means none). The tree is a binary search tree when, for every node, all values in its left subtree are strictly smaller than its value and all values in its right subtree are strictly larger.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The next `n` lines give `v_i`, the left child and the right child of node `i`.

## Output
Print `YES` if the tree is a binary search tree, otherwise `NO`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 8000`
- `1 <= v_i <= 10^9`
- The input is a valid binary tree rooted at node `1`.
